summary.one_liner: LibreNMS is an auto-discovering PHP/MySQL/SNMP network monitoring system with support for many network hardware and operating system vendors.
summary.what_it_does: LibreNMS is described as an auto-discovering network monitoring system built on PHP, MySQL and SNMP. The README says it supports a wide range of network hardware and operating systems, naming Cisco, Linux, FreeBSD, Juniper, Brocade, Foundry, HP and many more. Documentation is kept in the repository's doc directory and at docs.librenms.org, covering installation and contribution. The README also offers a VirtualBox VM image based on Ubuntu for trying the software. The project is run as a community that accepts contributions via GitHub pull requests, Discord, and community forums.
use_cases: auto-discover switches and routers on a network
monitor Cisco, Juniper, or HP network hardware
try a network monitoring system in a VirtualBox VM
how_to_run: Download one of the VirtualBox VM images listed in the README and follow the included documentation for login credentials and setup
notable: Broad hardware and OS vendor support including Cisco, Juniper, Brocade, Foundry, HP and Linux/FreeBSD
Prebuilt VirtualBox VM image for trial use
Governed by the Debian Social Contract as its priority basis
caveats: The README does not describe installation steps beyond pointing to the documentation
The only quick-start option in the README is the VirtualBox image, which is described as tested with VirtualBox only

keywords: see what devices are on my network
